snippet.title: Homemade Mushroom Biryani | Village Cooking Story #shorts #mushroombiryani #tamilcooking #viral
snippet.description:
தோட்டத்திலிருந்து பறித்த பிரெஷ்ஷான மஷ்ரூமை வைத்து, மண் பானையில விறகு அடுப்பில் மணக்க மணக்க கிராமத்து ஸ்டைல் மஷ்ரூம் பிரியாணி! கூடவே மொறுமொறுப்பான சோள வறுவல் 🌽

Fresh garden mushrooms cooked with Seeraga Samba rice in a traditional clay pot over a firewood stove. A delicious village-style Mushroom Biryani served with crispy corn fry. A nostalgic 1990s Tamil village cooking story.

🍄 Mushroom Biryani Ingredients

* Fresh mushrooms – 500 g
* Seeraga Samba rice – 2 cups (soaked for 20 minutes)
* Onion – 3 (thinly sliced)
* Tomato – 2
* Green chilli – 4
* Ginger garlic paste – 1 tbsp
* Thick curd – 1 cup
* Mint and coriander leaves – 1 handful each
* Bay leaf, cinnamon, cloves, cardamom
* Chilli powder, coriander powder, turmeric, biryani masala, salt
* Oil and ghee
* Water – 3 cups (1 : 1.5 ratio)

👩‍🍳 Method

1. Clean the mushrooms, cut into large pieces and gently pat dry with a cloth.
2. Lightly sauté the mushrooms in oil and set aside to remove excess moisture.
3. Heat oil and ghee in a clay pot. Add bay leaf, cinnamon, cloves and cardamom.
4. Add sliced onions and green chillies; sauté until golden.
5. Add ginger garlic paste, tomato, mint and coriander. Cook until soft.
6. Add spice powders, salt and thick curd. Cook until oil separates.
7. Gently fold in the mushrooms and add water. Bring to a boil.
8. Add soaked Seeraga Samba rice and stir only once.
9. Top with mint, coriander and ghee. Cover and cook on dum for 20 minutes over low fire, with hot coals on the lid.
10. Rest for 10 minutes before opening.

🌽 Crispy Corn Fry
Dry the boiled corn kernels. Coat with rice flour, gram flour, chilli powder and salt. Deep-fry in small batches until crispy.

snippet.description:
FAHR - Vom ersten Ackerschlepper bis zur Europareihe (ORIGINALAUFNAHMEN, Landtechnik Doku, HD Doku)

► Dokumentationen auf Deutsch und in voller Länge anschauen - jetzt abonnieren: http://bit.ly/TemporaAbo
► Vom ersten F 22 bis zur gemeinsam mit Güldner entwickelten Europareihe: Die Dokumentation erzählt die Geschichte der roten FAHR-Traktoren aus Gottmadingen. Historische Werksaufnahmen, Erinnerungen ehemaliger Mitarbeiter und erhaltene Maschinen machen ein Kapitel deutscher Landtechnikgeschichte lebendig.

FAHR - VOM ERSTEN ACKERSCHLEPPER BIS ZUR EUROPAREIHE (2006)
Originaltitel: FAHR – Vom ersten Ackerschlepper bis zur Europareihe
Mit: Ehemaligen FAHR-Werksangehörigen, Landwirten und Schleppersammlern
FSK: Als INFO-Programm gemäß § 14 JuSchG ausgewiesen

INHALTSANGABE:
Als FAHR 1938 mit dem F 22 seinen ersten Ackerschlepper vorstellt, ist das Unternehmen bereits als Hersteller landwirtschaftlicher Geräte bekannt. Die Dokumentation verfolgt den Einstieg in den Traktorenbau und die Entwicklung der Marke über die erfolgreichen Nachkriegsjahre bis zum Ende der Schlepperproduktion in Gottmadingen.
Modelle wie der D 22, D 25 und D 180 H stehen für den Aufschwung der 1950er-Jahre. Ein weiteres Kapitel bildet die Europareihe, die aus der Zusammenarbeit mit Güldner hervorgeht. Zugleich verändert die schrittweise Beteiligung von Klöckner-Humboldt-Deutz die Zukunft des Unternehmens: 1961 endet der Schlepperbau am Standort.
Originalaufnahmen aus dem ehemaligen Firmenarchiv ergänzen die Berichte früherer Werksangehöriger. Landwirte und Sammler zeigen ihre erhaltenen FAHR-Traktoren und erklären, was sie an den Maschinen bis heute schätzen.

snippet.title: Com treinamento, menina de 2 anos se salva de afogamento após cair na piscina | #PrimeiroImpacto
snippet.description:
Helena, de 2 anos, caiu de bicicleta em uma piscina de uma pousada em Aruanã (GO), por volta das 21h. Câmeras registraram a menina virando o corpo e se agarrando à borda em sete segundos. O tio, Marcos, pulou na água e a retirou em segurança. Segundo a mãe, Hyolly Klein, Helena faz natação com foco em sobrevivência desde os seis meses, o que pode ter ajudado na reação. A empresária publicou o vídeo para destacar a prevenção de acidentes, e as imagens já somam milhares de visualizações. Saiba todos os detalhes no Primeiro Impacto.

snippet.title: لماذا يرفض لامين يامال اعتبار ميسي قدوته؟
snippet.description:
تفاصيل الموقف الطريف الذي جمع موهبة برشلونة الشابة لامين يامال بعدد من المشجعين المراهقين أثناء تصوير مقطع فيديو على قناته، وكشفه عن هوية مثله الأعلى الحقيقي في عالم كرة القدم. يتناول الفيديو دهشة الجماهير بعد إعلان يامال أن البرازيلي نيمار دا سيلفا هو قدوته الفنية في الملاعب وليس أسطورة النادي ليونيل ميسي، رغم ارتدائه القميص رقم عشرة واللعب في نفس المركز وبالقدم اليسرى، مع استعراض الأسباب الفنية والنفسية وراء هذا الاختيار ورغبة اللاعب الشاب في الهروب من ضغط المقارنات التاريخية مع أفضل لاعب في تاريخ النادي الكتالوني.

snippet.title: Gazas humanitäre Krise: Kommt jetzt Bewegung in den Konflikt? | Markus Lanz vom 11. November 2026
snippet.description:
Nach den Wahlen in Israel richtet sich der Blick auf die Regierungsbildung und die Rolle Gadi Eisenkots. Zugleich bleibt die Lage in Gaza verheerend. Regenfälle setzen die Camps unter Was-ser, trotz Waffenruhe kommt es weiter zu Angriffen. SPD-Politiker Ralf Stegner wirft Europa vor, keinen wirksamen Beitrag zu einer Lösung geleistet zu haben. Er fordert, die Perspektiven beider Seiten zu berücksichtigen und das humanitäre Völkerrecht ohne Ausnahme zum Maßstab zu machen. Warum fällt die Debatte darüber in Deutschland so schwer? Wird das Leid der palästinensischen Bevölkerung ausreichend wahrgenommen und was kann sich nach der Wahl für Israelis und Palästinenser ändern?


Den gesamten Talk findet ihr hier: https://kurz.zdf.de/c9n/
 


Weitere Gäste in der Sendung:
Mariam Lau, Journalistin 
Thomas Reichart, ZDF-Korrespondent

snippet.title: 🏹 A Dramatic Ravan Dahan Gone Comically Wrong
snippet.description:
Witness the hilarious outcome of a festive celebration when a traditional Ravan Dahan takes an unexpected turn. As a young man prepares to ignite a towering effigy with a flaming arrow, he expects a grand display, but the resulting pyrotechnics quickly spiral into total chaos. Instead of a controlled spectacle, the effigy erupts in a shower of sparks and stray fireworks that sends everyone scrambling for cover.

Watch as the massive structure wobbles and collapses, leaving our archer covered in soot and laughing off the surprise. It is a moment of pure, unintended slapstick comedy set against the backdrop of a lively night festival. The festive energy remains high even as the pyrotechnics go rogue, turning a serious cultural tradition into an unforgettable and humorous sight. See why sometimes the best-laid plans lead to the most entertaining results when things do not quite go according to plan.

The soldier firmly reminded everyone: “All visitors will maintain an atmosphere of silence and respect at all times.” The Tomb honours unidentified American service members who died in war and is guarded 24 hours a day by soldiers of the US Army's 3rd Infantry Regiment, known as The Old Guard.

The incident is a reminder that the rules of respect at this sacred memorial apply to everyone, regardless of rank or position.

snippet.title: The Secret Behind India's Western Ghats Rivers  #geography #westernghats
snippet.description:
The Godavari, the Krishna and the Kaveri all begin in the Western Ghats, a range with no glaciers and no permanent snow. Their water starts over the Arabian Sea. Each summer the south-west monsoon carries moist air to the coast, the Ghats force it to rise, and the windward slopes get more than 200 cm of rain a year (orographic rainfall). Forest soil and weathered rock soak up part of that rain and release it slowly, so streams keep flowing after the monsoon. But with no ice in reserve, many of these rivers run low by summer. West-flowing rivers such as the Mandovi and the Sharavathi rise in the same range.

snippet.title: The baby wasn’t expected to survive her father’s beating. 19 years later, she danced at her own prom
snippet.description:
Christiona "Onna" Shelley was just 5 weeks old when she was nearly beaten to death by her father.

Chris Shelly, her namesake, punched his then-infant daughter in the head and slapped her when he couldn't get her to stop crying, according to police records.

Onna stopped crying. And her brain bled inside her tiny skull for two days before her parents took her to a Syracuse emergency room.
By then, it seemed too late. At the hospital, doctors declared Onna brain dead and suggested taking her off life support.

But Onna woke up. Her grandmother, Adina Moyer, took her home. Ever since, she has beaten the odds — from learning to walk and talk to graduating from high school.

And now, Onna has danced at her own prom. Her grandma, who raised her, turned Onna's graduation party in Central New York into the dance party she never got to attend.

"That prom that we're holding for her is so important, you know," Moyer said, "so she doesn't miss out on life."

📽️: Chloe Troffater
🖋️: Marnie Eisenstadt
📷: Adina Moyer, The Post-Standard's archives
